'''Docking Bay 77''' was a docking bay that was located in [[Gadrin Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Nadin Paal]] maintained a warehouse at the docking bay and during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Kills]] traveled to the bay, planning to ambush and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Paal.
